architecture_claims.statement: Anthropic publishes a constitution describing behavioral principles; it is governance/training-policy evidence rather than internal model architecture.

mechanism_candidates.falsification_test: Compare prose-only governance against compiled test cases on a fixed adversarial suite.
mechanism_candidates.hypothesized_effect: Reduce drift between stated principles and evaluated behavior.
mechanism_candidates.semantic_definition: Compile general behavioral principles into specific positive and adversarial conformance tests.
mechanism_candidates.source_fact_boundary: The public constitution establishes a principle corpus; implementation and causal transfer details remain unobserved.
